subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should cron quarantine recovery archives be silently limited to five files, or should OpenClaw use a different bounded retention and recovery-visible policy?
rationale: The byte cap and archive rotation are a concrete bug fix, but selecting how much historical quarantined user configuration may be deleted is a persistent recovery-data policy choice rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve five silent archives
options.body: Accept the proposed fixed five-file retention limit and merge it as the supported recovery policy.

options.title: Specify recovery-visible retention
options.body: Define a bounded count or byte policy with an operator-visible recovery/cleanup signal before landing the archive-pruning behavior.

options.title: Keep the cap without pruning
options.body: Land only bounded reads and overflow handling, leaving archive retention for a separately approved policy.

recommendation.title: Specify recovery-visible retention
recommendation.body: Define a bounded count or byte policy with an operator-visible recovery/cleanup signal before landing the archive-pruning behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline indicates this reviewer was directly brought into the retention-policy discussion.
